locationHint: Map and Street View use this record's coordinates. Source time is shown unchanged.
endpointsHint: Choose a recorded point. Source times are shown unchanged, without assuming a time zone.
pointHint: The pin uses the selected source coordinates.
streetViewHint: Explore nearby surroundings. Imagery may be older, offset from the point or unavailable. It is not a live truck camera or evidence of conditions at the source time. Exploring does not change the recorded point.
routeHint: Google suggests driving directions between the recorded start and end. This is not a recording of the truck's movement.
notConfigured: Embedded preview is unavailable. Open the selected view in Google Maps.
googleDisclosure: Opening the Google link sends these coordinates to Google.
embeddedDisclosure: The selected view loads automatically and sends these coordinates to Google.
previewFallback: If the view fails to load or no imagery is available, use the Google link above or return to the recorded point. Source facts remain available here.
noCoordinates: No valid coordinates are available for this map.
incompleteRoute: Only one recorded endpoint is available. Map and Street View use that point; suggested directions require both endpoints.
